cause_quote: When post-failure recovery admission refused, the unwind threw `new UpdateCommandPendingRecoveryFailure(primaryResult(failure?.error), formatErrorMessage(error), ...)`, printing only the admission refusal and dropping the original failure's message.
user_saw: A failed update printed only 'Update <run> has unfinished recovery; reconcile it before starting another update.' with no sign of the error that actually stopped it and no next command.
summary: Appends a redacted 'First failure: ...' line to the pending-recovery failure and names `openclaw update repair` when repair can settle the run's plugin cohort.
reasoning: The unwind file was created in 000af986 (#140339), whose admission-refusal catch formatted the pending failure from the refusal alone; later refactors (d780fdc, 16095df's pendingFailure helper) kept formatErrorMessage(cause) unchanged, so the first failure was never shown. Treated as a diagnostics defect that shipped with the path rather than a pure copy change because the root cause was unrecoverable from output; confidence is medium since the original error may have survived in the result object.
